interactions.label: HARBOUR OFFICE
interactions.dialog:
THE HARBOUR OFFICE OF CROWNHAVEN. A CLERK BEHIND EVERY WINDOW, A LEDGER FOR EVERY KEEL.

THE HARBOURMASTER WORKS ON THE QUAY, NOT IN HERE.

interactions.label: BONDED STORE
interactions.dialog: CROWN BONDED STORE. EVERY CRATE IN HERE HAS PAID ITS DUTY, OR IS WAITING TO.

interactions.label: THE CROWN & ANCHOR
interactions.dialog:
THE CROWN & ANCHOR. SINGING INSIDE, AND SOMEBODY WINNING AT DICE.

A SLATE BY THE DOOR: "HANDS WANTED - ASK THE HARBOURMASTER. NO PIRATES (AGAIN)."

interactions.label: MERCHANTS' EXCHANGE
interactions.dialog:
THE MERCHANTS' EXCHANGE. UNDER THE CLOCK, TRADERS FROM ALL FIVE SEAS SHOUT PRICES AT EACH OTHER.

THE BOARD INSIDE: SPORE SILK UP, MOON SALT UP, NOBODY WANTS SALT FISH TODAY.

interactions.label: ST BRENDAN'S
interactions.dialog:
ST BRENDAN'S, PATRON OF THOSE WHO SAIL. THE ROSE WINDOW GLOWS ALL NIGHT FOR SHIPS STILL OUT.

INSIDE, CANDLES FOR THE MISSING, ROW ON ROW. ONE SAYS "THE WREN".

interactions.label: FOUNTAIN
interactions.dialog: THE CROWN FOUNTAIN. COINS AT THE BOTTOM FROM EVERY PORT ON THE SEA, AND A FEW FROM PLACES NOBODY HAS HEARD OF.

interactions.label: STATUE
interactions.dialog: CAPTAIN MIRA LUMAR, WHO FIRST CHARTED THE FIVE SEAS. THE PLAQUE: "SHE FOUND THEM ALL, AND KEPT LOOKING."

interactions.label: PALACE GATE
interactions.dialog:
THE PALACE OF THE EMERALD CROWN. THE GATES ARE SHUT; THE GUARDS SAY THE QUEEN-REGENT SEES NOBODY WITHOUT A LETTER.

ONE OF THEM ADDS, QUIETLY: "UNLESS YOU OWN A FLEET."

interactions.label: ROYAL YARD
interactions.dialog:
THE ROYAL YARD. A GALLEON IN FRAME ON THE STOCKS, RIBS LIKE A WHALE'S. THE SHIPWRIGHTS SAY SHE'LL TAKE A YEAR.

THE HARBOURMASTER TAKES ORDERS FOR GALLEONS - "IF YOU'VE THE COIN."

interactions.label: NOTICE BOARD
interactions.dialog: NOTICES: GALLEON HULLS - ROYAL YARD. CARRIERS WANTED FOR SILK TO SAPPHIRE. PIRATES SIGHTED OFF THE CRIMSON SEAM - CONVOY THURSDAY.

interactions.label: LIGHTHOUSE
interactions.dialog: THE CROWN LIGHT, ITS LAMP BURNING GREEN FOR THE EMERALD SEA. THE KEEPER WAVES FROM THE GALLERY.

interactions.label: MARKET
interactions.dialog: APPLES FROM THE NORTH GARDENS, BREAD STILL WARM, A CRATE OF PEARS FROM SOMEWHERE THAT ISN'T HERE.

interactions.label: FISH MARKET
interactions.dialog: THE CATCH ON ICE: SILVERFIN, CRAB, A RAY AS BIG AS A DOOR.

interactions.label: SPICE STALL
interactions.dialog: SPICES FROM ALL FIVE SEAS IN LITTLE JARS. THE TRADER LETS YOU SMELL THE MOON SALT: IT SMELLS OF NOTHING AT ALL.

interactions.label: BOOKSTALL
interactions.dialog: CHARTS, ALMANACS, A BATTERED COPY OF "THE LADY OF THE EMERALD SEA". SOMEBODY HAS ANNOTATED EVERY PAGE.

interactions.label: FISHING JETTY
interactions.dialog: THE FISHING JETTY. LANTERNS ALONG IT, AND A CHALKED SIGN: "NO FISHING FROM THE ROYAL PIER."
